relation_assertion_policy: Named relations to Ancestor Intelligence remain source propositions only; endpoint identity and Program Map edges are not resolved or emitted.
formal_policy: Formal models are preserved with the source's explicit standing as candidate variables/hypotheses rather than fixed laws. No dimensional, construct-validity or causal-identification authority is added by parsing.
experimental_policy: Hypotheses, falsification criteria and six experimental designs are prospective. No executable experiment, run record, empirical result, negative result or replication is present on the frozen surface.
case_study_policy: Language, mathematics, scientific method, programming, biology and AI are source applications/interpretations. The source explicitly states they do not prove ASEB.
limitation_policy: The source's limitations and open problems remain limitations/open questions. They are not empirical negative results and are not silently repaired by other files.
absence_policy: The 11-file frozen head is documentation-only; this bounded absence does not assert that no related experiment has ever been run elsewhere.
temporal_policy: Current-head semantic parse remains separate from the 12-commit developmental trajectory.
